post.description: Media-upload variant of messages.send: the request body is the whole RFC 822 message as raw bytes (Content-Type message/rfc822, uploadType=media), not JSON and not base64url. Use it to send a message with a staged attachment via codemode.request's `composed` channel. Gmail's limit is 35 MiB for the whole message.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

parameters.name: uploadType
parameters.description: Must be `media`: the body is the raw RFC 822 message.

post.description: Media-upload variant of drafts.create: the request body is the whole RFC 822 message as raw bytes (Content-Type message/rfc822, uploadType=media), not JSON and not base64url. Use it to create a draft with a staged attachment via codemode.request's `composed` channel. Gmail's limit is 35 MiB for the whole message.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

parameters.name: uploadType
parameters.description: Must be `media`: the body is the raw RFC 822 message.

put.description: Media-upload variant of drafts.update: replaces the draft's content with the RFC 822 message carried as raw bytes (Content-Type message/rfc822, uploadType=media), not JSON and not base64url. Use it to put a staged attachment into an existing draft via codemode.request's `composed` channel. Gmail's limit is 35 MiB for the whole message.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user's email address. The special value `me` can be used to indicate the authenticated user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the draft to update.

parameters.name: uploadType
parameters.description: Must be `media`: the body is the raw RFC 822 message.
